scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana- Madhya Pradesh
other_conditions: Parents of the bride or groom must be natives of Madhya Pradesh; otherwise benefits are not available
Bride must be at least 18 years old and must not have been previously married
Groom must be at least 21 years old
Marriage must take place in a mass marriage ceremony organized under the scheme, not a single ceremony
Abandoned women are eligible only if they have been legally divorced
A minimum of five couples is required for a mass marriage ceremony to be organized
benefits_summary: Each eligible bride receives a total of ₹49,000 as a lump‑sum payment on the day of the mass marriage ceremony (₹55,000 total per beneficiary including the organizing body).
